blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines is looking to the United States as an alternative supplier — and not its sole source of its food and energy requirements as earlier claimed by US President Donald Trump — amid concerns over potential supply disruptions and rising prices, Malacañang said on Sunday.
